system.description:
You Place your palm on the ground and conduct a jolt of lightning that runs through it towards a target creature in range. This jutsu ignores line of sight and can go around corners. Target creature must make a constitution save, taking 3d6 Lightning damage and gaining 1 rank of Shaken on a failed save and only half damage on a successful one.

Overcharge. A creature who fails their saving throw gain an additional rank of Shaken.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, its range becomes 60 Feet (10-Foot Cube) centered on a point within range. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, and a creature fails their saving throw, they lose the ability to make Hand Seals (HS) until the end of each of their next turn. Additionally, if you Overcharge this jutsu’s range can become Self (60-Foot Cone).
